name: Waveform
description: Periodic waveform (sine, square, triangle, sawtooth, bounce, ramp, smooth) over the modifier phase. The wave peak lands on the base value; strength sets how deep the trough goes. Start/end restrict the active part of each cycle; outside it the value holds at the offset, or at base × floor when the floor is enabled.

params.label: Shape amount
params.description: Duty cycle (square), peak position (triangle/smooth), direction (sawtooth), bounce count, ramp softness.

params.label: Offset
params.description: Vertical baseline shift of the wave; also the hold value outside start/end.

params.label: Floor
params.description: Hold at base × floor outside start/end, independent of strength.
